# Release notes template

Use this structure for a human-readable release summary. Remove empty sections and replace placeholders with changes verified against the previous tag. Do not publish the template itself.

## What changed

- Describe the user problem and the behavior now available in this version.
- Link to the relevant usage guide and state any platform or configuration requirements.

## Fixes

- Explain observable fixes rather than listing internal refactors.

## Upgrade notes

- List changed permissions, config, migrations, and extension/client compatibility.
- Distinguish core, desktop, mobile, and browser extension distribution versions.
- State known preview limitations or checks users should make after upgrading.

## Downloads

Use the website for current installer selection and the release assets for exact historical versions. Include checksums when supplied.

**Full Changelog**: link to the comparison between the actual previous tag and this tag.
